criteria.TP: The finding holds against the text of the requirements it cites.
criteria.BORDERLINE: Defensible but resting on one reading of an underspecified requirement, or extrapolating beyond what the requirements entail.
criteria.FP: The finding does not hold. Includes gaps whose supposedly missing requirement is present elsewhere in the collection.

format: key = C<cluster>|<category>|<index>; value = VERDICT or VERDICT|reason

verdicts.C0|inconsistencies|1: BORDERLINE|conflict holds only under the reading of R86 as 'stay of one week'; under the equally plausible 'one-week window' reading R86 refines R250 with no contradiction. The model itself flags R86 as ambiguous.
verdicts.C3|gaps|1: FP|mandatory fields ARE specified in the collection: R95 (photos), R98 (cost per night) and R222 (description) forbid publication without them. They sit in cluster C6, so the isolation rule hides them.
verdicts.C3|gaps|2: FP|editing a listing is specified by R158 (C7) and R65 (C7), deleting by R19 (C11). The capability exists in the collection; the gap is an artifact of the partition.
verdicts.C4|inconsistencies|2: BORDERLINE|the conflict is conditional on reading a booking as a 'single purchase', a term R137 leaves undefined; the model itself hedges with 'if'. Worth surfacing, not an established contradiction.
verdicts.C4|gaps|2: FP|a user-visible transaction history is specified by R182 (C9): 'show the user the history of their points with date time point change and description'.
verdicts.C6|gaps|1: FP|the data the gap calls missing is captured by existing requirements: the listing city by R240 (C3) and the user's university data by R113 (C10).
verdicts.C7|gaps|2: FP|deletion is specified by R19 (C11), 'Students must be able to delete their room (if saved)'.
verdicts.C9|gaps|1: BORDERLINE|an administrative balance-correction function is not strongly implied by R10/R92; the prompt forbids speculation, and this is closer to a design suggestion than to a gap the existing requirements entail.
verdicts.C10|gaps|1: FP|password management is not a gap but a consequence of the design: authentication is delegated to the university's service (R61, R111, R165, R189 in this same cluster), so credentials are not held by the system.
verdicts.C10|gaps|3: BORDERLINE|configurable notification preferences are a reasonable product suggestion but are not entailed by R174; closer to speculation than to a gap implied by the existing requirements.
verdicts.C11|duplicates|3: BORDERLINE|R216 cancels a submitted request (before acceptance) while R27 and R84 cancel a confirmed booking; these are related but distinct states, so the group is not the 'identical' set the finding claims and merging them would lose a distinction.
